Published a distinct reviewer-owned draft, #150, at `48b39628a6fd36873045f5a9782e445a12d35fdb`: [assessment](https://github.com/lmmx/mibz2/blob/48b39628a6fd36873045f5a9782e445a12d35fdb/docs/journal/compact30-adversarial/scanner-146/report.md). Evidence digest: `e18b6ff9d866ef66a32b287b5cb0f4f81b54cffc038e2275f3513bd76a2691de`. This is the independent adversarial role, separate from the principal researcher's canonical ledger.

Existing #148 F1/F2 and ACK 6630284404 are corroborated, not resubmitted. Safe-scanner nonqualification and the withdrawal of a conservative whole-constructor interval stand.

New analytical detail:
- The final ordinary full-tile loops remain 12 instructions. Added refill-wrapper work is 4,892,683 instructions; the first wrapper's extra stores account for 99.886% of the own-body write increase. These are event-weighted architectural counts, not recovery of missing raw inclusive Dr/Dw.
- LOW coverage clarification: `n1=17` can leave U1 inside the parent slice on an interior tile. A combined Miri failure at U2 does not separately validate U1-bound coverage. The report recommends separate endpoint controls without changing the registered experiment.
- U3's current phase premise follows from all advance bounds plus bulk phase preservation. That mathematical proof does not review a future intrinsic or expand the recorded U1/U2-only trial.
- Two conditional static targets address redundant split/phase state. They earn no achieved net credit; their compiler targets, residual costs and overlap are explicit.

Four static replays, 46 input hashes, governing/frozen Git blobs and a fresh package critique passed. No constructor was changed, compiled or run. No implementation permission, scope change, new measurement or §6.2 acceptance is conveyed. I contributed to the new hypotheses and validation suggestions, so a later formal audit of an adopted design must disclose non-independence and use fresh review where required.
